# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 113 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 52-53 | Coptic

---

## Saying 113

His disciples said to him: "When will the kingdom come?" Jesus said: "It will not come by watching for it. It will not be said: 'Look, here!' or 'Look, there!' Rather, the kingdom of the Father is spread out upon the earth, and people do not see it."

---

**Translator's Notes (EMET):**

- Parallel to Luke 17:20-21; Thomas is close to Luke but adds "spread out upon the earth"
- "Not come by watching for it" — the kingdom is not observable, not an external event
- "Spread out upon the earth" — **ⲡⲱϩ** / *pōh*: spread out, extended; the kingdom is already present everywhere
- "People do not see it" — the blindness is the obstacle, not the absence
- Thomas's version: the kingdom is already here, spread upon the earth; the problem is seeing it
- Luke's "within you" (entos humōn) may be a parallel — Thomas externalizes it to the earth
